answer: Every identity's standing resets to zero each season on the Crystal ledger, so no claim pays until its filer finishes the Wander round: three small checked jobs for three different buyers. The Prism desk verifies each job within a day against its sealed work sample; a faked sample voids the claim and forfeits a 250-coin bond. A thousand fakes would need 3,000 real jobs plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty claims under forty names and watched them all fail the first check.
